items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: But we used soprano sax, Arnie Lawrence played that, and David Grisman on mandolin, they played the melody, and John Goldsby acoustic bass, Vignola played a couple of tracks of guitar. And there were no drums. I played bongo, shakers and a couple other things.

ctx.x: Yeah. And the royalties are good. So yeah, I’ll hear a tune in a certain style and then I know what instrument it needs to be played upon, and I just go from there. It all comes together all at once. So it’s funny, like one tune I wrote actually it was the title tune of a

Frank Vignola Concord record called “Let it Happen.” I wrote this tune “Let it Happen.” But we used soprano sax, Arnie Lawrence played that, and David Grisman on mandolin, they played the melody, and John Goldsby acoustic bass, Vignola played a couple of tracks of guitar. And there were no drums. I played bongo, shakers and a couple other things. I didn’t hear drums in it. So that was pretty obscure instrumentation. And then we just did a record with Frank Wess and Mark Egan, Frank Vignola.
